scope: Native PERF-06–13 fixture; single reader; driver commands including transaction control. No Railway latency SLO.
basis: PERF-13 repeated 20-sample matched run, pool maximum 3, 40ms per submitted command
latencyPolicy: Investigation bands include about 25% over the repeated measured p95. Observe only; do not fail shared Railway traffic or default CI wall-clock time. Concurrent reader stages have their own distributions and are not compared to single-reader bands.
